notes: Triggers when 6+ grey nomads are within 12 tiles of the player (or immediately via #mg hash). Eight nomads form a ring at distance 180. Left-click brightens the flame (+0.15), which naturally decays (-0.008/frame). The steady band (center drifts via sine wave) is ±0.12 around the drifting center. Nomads approach only when flame is in-band; they recoil if too bright (>0.85) or drift away if too dim (<0.25). Win: all nomads reach distance ≤22 while flame is steady; converts 3 nearby greys to v=8. Fail: flame exceeds 0.9 (flare) or drops below 0.15 (gutter). Exit transitions occur after 80 frames (win) or 60 frames (fail). The encounter dims the world with a 0.6 alpha overlay and draws all bodies as circles+rects directly into this.overlay.
